name: Solomon Data International Corporation
summary: Solomon Data International Corporation specializes in the development and distribution of liquid crystal display (LCD) modules, serving markets in Taiwan and China. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes monochromatic, intelligent, and integrated LCMs, as well as advanced Thin-Film Transistor (TFT) modules and specialized coding system services. The company supplies these components to a diverse clientele of manufacturers and distributors across numerous sectors, such as telecommunications, computing, networking equipment, industrial machinery, navigation, transportation, instrumentation, and medical devices. Established in 1990, Solomon Data International Corporation is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, and operates as a subsidiary of Solomon Co., Ltd.
